name: at-peace
description: A calm, intentional YouTube: hide what you don't want to see and add a little friction between you and the feed.
author: Cristian Bagrin

scripts.test:firefox: bash tests/firefox/setup.sh && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning --test --test-reporter=spec --test-concurrency=1 --test-timeout=300000 tests/firefox/smoke.mjs tests/firefox/engine.mjs tests/firefox/ui.mjs tests/firefox/mindful.mjs tests/firefox/overlay.mjs tests/firefox/picker.mjs tests/firefox/features.mjs tests/firefox/youtube7b.mjs tests/firefox/lock.mjs tests/firefox/catalog.mjs
